Megan Ortiz: Heads up — Alex put in notice today, last day is 1846200000 (Fri). Need to coordinate benefits cutoff, laptop return, and access deprovisioning.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. I can be flexible on the exact last active working day if that helps. Happy to hand off docs.
Megan Ortiz: Quick checklist: benefits/COBRA timing, final paycheck timing, calendar/email forwarding, Okta/Slack removal, laptop return logistics.
Linda (Benefits): We'll send COBRA election notices within 7 business days after the separation is processed. Benefits coverage typically ends the last day of the month unless special enrollments apply. I can confirm with payroll on the final pay date.
Alex Chen: I expect a partial-month final paycheck — can payroll confirm gross vs net timing? Also I have an AWS access key in a personal script that needs rotation guidance.
Tony Ruiz: @Alex please remove any personal creds from repos and shared drives immediately. IT will do a credential sweep on day-of. We plan to run deprovision at 06:00 UTC the morning after last_day to avoid in-day disruptions.
Megan Ortiz: That works. Can someone add a quick deprovision schedule so I can include it in the offboarding calendar invite?
Tony Ruiz: Here's the high-level deprovision list we use:
```
- Revoke Okta SSO and disable account
- Remove GSuite mailbox or set auto-forward to manager for 30 days
- Remove Slack access (archive DMs per policy)
- Revoke cloud console roles and project access
- Revoke service-account keys and rotate creds in infra
- Disable VPN + remove from MFA devices
- Flag hardware return: laptop + power cable + dongles
```
Megan Ortiz: Perfect. @hr-bot can you trigger the standard offboard doc and send the COBRA/benefits summary to Alex?
hr-bot: Offboarding checklist initiated. Sending standard separation email and benefits packet to Alex Chen.
Linda (Benefits): @Alex note: COBRA election window is 60 days from the date of the Qualifying Event. Benefits premium responsibility begins on the date you elect coverage. We'll include FAQs in the packet.
Alex Chen: Thanks Linda. For laptop return — I travel next week. Could IT provide prepaid shipping label?
Tony Ruiz: Yes. We'll email a prepaid label and instructions by EOD. Please wipe anything personal from the laptop before shipping (we'll run a full audit).
Megan Ortiz: Action items recap: Linda — confirm final paycheck date + send benefits packet; Tony — shipping label + deprovision schedule; hr-bot — send standard offboard email and exit interview link; Alex — confirm last active working date and cleanup personal creds. I’ll send a calendar invite for the final-week check-ins.
Alex Chen: Last active working date = 1846196400 (Thu) — I’ll finish handoffs and docs then. Appreciate everyone. :wave:
Megan Ortiz: Thanks — I’ll follow up once payroll confirms the final pay cutoff. :thumbsup:
Tony Ruiz: Noted. We’ll plan deprovision the morning after final active day unless Megan requests otherwise.
hr-bot: Exit interview form scheduled — Alex Chen will receive a calendar invite for 30 minutes.
Megan Ortiz: Closing loop here in 24h after payroll confirmation. If anyone spots anything missing, flag it in this thread. :eyes:
